main_text.p: In multitudine tranquillitatis, irregulariter scriptum & punctatum, nempe & transpositis, & cum praefixo ׳ impositis duobus punctis, ac si esset numeri pluralis, שנא Annus; in multitudine annorum. Notat Fra. Raphelengius in variis lectionibus, ex codice manuscripto Coloniensi collectis, ex illo codice restituendum videri
שיך Ch. Monile, armilla, catena, catenula, Esth. 8. 15. Catena ferrea, Psal. 105. 18. Plur. שירין, Monilia, catenae, armillae: compedes, Psal. 149. 8. Hami, 2. Reg. 19. 28. Constr. שרי.
שיראה Ch. Idem, Esth. 5. 1. & 6. 10. in T. sec.
שירת, שירא, שיר Ch. Turma, caterva, exercitus. Plural. שירת, שירן.
שיש Hebr. Marmor, Hinc Ch. באבניששא Lapidibus marmoreis, Esth. 1. 2. in Targ. sec.
* שיתא שירת Ch. Agnus, Levit. 5. 2. & 22. 8. Hebr. שה.

שכב Ch. & Syr. Jacere, cubare, accumbere, decubere, concumbere, incumbere, recumbere, occumbere. Dicitur de dormientibus, aegrotis, mortuis, & concumbentibus. Vide Drus. in Praet. pag. 139. & 299. Ithpeh. Fut. נשיהון ישתכבן Foeminae eorum vitiabuntur, concubitu violabuntur, Jesa. 13. 16. Zac. 14. 2. Ex Aphel Praeterit. ואשכבתרי Et cubare, dormire

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as far as legible; the first Syriac line and the Hebrew-pointed entries are only approximated. Catchword absent; the last line "mire" is the catchword-like fragment at the foot right, kept as printed.
